name: Darsh Bhagat
player_statement:
A complete player, Darsh Bhagat has made a big mark in cricket. With 11 turns at the crease, they've hit a top score of 43, with an average of 8.64 and a quick strike rate of 48.47. Their knack for hitting big shots is evident with 7 sixes and 8 fours.

Equally good at bowling, they've bowled 32.5 overs, taking 9 wickets at an economy rate of 4.26. Despite a few wides, their accuracy is top-notch, making them a key player for their team.
